title: COVID-19 risk profiles of Hong Kong constituencies (similarity search + multivariate clustering)
output_type: vector (constituencies with risk scores and cluster) + map
required_outputs: risk_profiles.shp (instruction names no file; any map PNG or result vector/table accepted)
method: For each of four attribute sets (transmission: PopDensity, SpInterIdx; susceptibility: PopDensity, Seniors60t, spending_c, keyfacts_p; resource scarcity: Seniors60t, SUM_Beds; exposure: RelativeCa) rank the 431 constituencies by similarity to the worst-case target (z-standardised attributes, sum of squared differences; SIMRANK 1 = most similar), join on ID and store 432 - SIMRANK. Cluster the four scores with K-means on standardised fields, initial centres = the 3 constituencies with SEEDS = 1 (A14, B02, J35).

key_parameters.similarity: ATTRIBUTE_VALUES, z-score standardisation, MOST_SIMILAR, all candidates ranked
key_parameters.clustering: K-means, k = 3 (number of seeds), init = SEEDS features, standardised analysis fields

benchmark_defects: The instruction names no output file (the published ArcPy script writes output/risk_profiles.shp, outside pred_results).
Domain knowledge says the target holds 'the smallest purchasing power value', but target spending_c (123.9) is the maximum; the target is used as supplied.

K-means on these scores has several near-equivalent optima: the SEEDS-initialised partition and k-means++ partitions agree only at ARI ~0.33 although both explain the same variance, so cluster identity cannot be required without the seeds.
checks: required: output written (non-blank PNG or result vector/table)
required: transmission risk score Spearman >= 0.95 with gold (aligned on ID, raw input columns excluded)

required: a 2-10 class cluster column (numeric or text/categorical labels) whose partition explains >= 0.90 of the variance explained by the best K-means partition (same k) of the standardised gold risk scores
required (the domain knowledge prescribes K-means with SEEDS as initialization field): method fidelity - a 3-class cluster column with ARI >= 0.8 to the SEEDS-initialised gold
